title: Create, configure, execute
purpose: Explain command encapsulation and deferred invocation using the article's Light example.
alt: 클라이언트의 명령 생성·등록과 리모컨의 execute 호출, Light 수신자의 on 실행 과정
requiredChecks: Client creates Light receiver and LightOnCommand(light), then passes that command to SimpleRemoteControl.setCommand().
Invoker holds a Command and buttonWasPressed() calls slot.execute().
LightOnCommand encapsulates the Light receiver; its execute() delegates to light.on().
Creation/configuration precede later invocation; invoker does not call Light.on() directly.
